method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Box-and-cylinder camera in a grey-middle room with a lit band behind the dek; the transcript small and far back.
notes.fix: Model the camcorder, drop the back wall to black under one window rake, and pull the transcript into that pool at one scale.

notes.problem: Primitive camcorder, a leg through a label, a ceiling seam behind the hook, a mid-brown wall.
notes.fix: Model a pro camcorder turned three-quarters, move the label clear, and drop the ceiling and wall into the dark.

notes.problem: Primitive camcorder dominating; brown mid-tone wall; no one scale comparison.
notes.fix: Build the camcorder with a hood and grip, move it beside the transcript at matched scale, and drop the wall fill behind one window rake.

notes.problem: Tiny justices on a thin strip over 40 percent dead floor.
notes.fix: Move forward and lower so the bench fills a third of the frame height.

notes.problem: Thin bench band of mannequins, empty floor, lectern under the footer.
notes.fix: Lower to 1.2 m and push in on a longer lens so the bench fills the middle third; seat the lectern in the lower left above the footer band.

notes.problem: Thin bench band with tiny figures over an empty floor.
notes.fix: Move about 4 m in on a longer lens so the bench fills the middle third and rim-light the empty chair.

notes.problem: The open transcript reads as clipping into the nosing; a lighter band along the top edge.
notes.fix: Seat it on the tread face in front of the nosing with a contact shadow, move closer, and let the band fall into black.

notes.problem: Transcript reads sunk behind a nosing; top band and a left glass slab remain; repeats the cover at thumb.
notes.fix: Seat the transcript in front of the nosing, move 30 percent closer, darken the top band and remove the slab.

notes.problem: Top 40 percent void with a strip at the top edge; book reads sunk between treads; far windows missing.
notes.fix: Pitch up so door spill and a line of lit windows fill the top third, and seat the book on the nearest tread at twice its width.

notes.problem: A plate behind the counter and a mid-tone facade.
notes.fix: Reframe so the tower clears the counter zone or let that corner fall into shadow.

notes.problem: Punched plate behind the counter, a cool rim, an orange speckle ground under a hazy band, a featureless transcript.
notes.fix: Re-aim so the facade top sits below the furniture row, kill the cool fill, and build the pale granite ledge in the pool with the horizon falling to black.

notes.problem: Counter on a plate; emissive-looking transcript; tiling facade.
notes.fix: Shift the courthouse so the counter falls on sky and light the transcript from the key with a contact shadow.

notes.problem: Bare pole pines and a flat pale left wall; a dead left third.
notes.fix: Model pine crowns against the seam and darken the room's left wall.

notes.problem: Transcript about 40 px; flat side face; dead lower fifth.
notes.fix: Crop so the base sits at the bottom edge, scale the transcript up about 4x in its own pool, and joint the side face.

notes.problem: Pale slab left of the doors; doors read as toy boxes; plain transcript.
notes.fix: Darken the slab, model bronze mullions and a lit vestibule, and give the transcript its cover and posts.
